an3.84:1.1: [vesālīnidānaṃ] evaṃ me sutaṃ : ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an3.84:1.2: atha kho aññataro vajjiputtako bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so vajjiputtako bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an3.84:1.3: sādhikamidaṃ bhante, diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasataṃ anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati.
an3.84:1.5: sakkasi pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhituṃ
an3.84:1.9: tasmātiha tvaṃ bhikkhu, tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhassu
an3.84:2.1: yato kho tvaṃ bhikkhu adhisīlampi sikkhissasi, adhicittampi sikkhissasi, adhipaññampi sikkhissasi, tassa tuyhaṃ bhikkhu adhisīlampi sikkhato adhicittampi sikkhato adhipaññampi sikkhato rāgo pahīyissati, doso pahīyissati, moho pahīyissati.
an3.84:2.2: so tvaṃ rāgassa pahāṇā, dosassa pahāṇā, mohassa pahāṇā yaṃ akusalaṃ na taṃ karissasi, yaṃ pāpaṃ na taṃ sevissasīti.
an3.84:3.1: atha kho so bhikkhu aparena samayena adhisīlampi sikkhi, adhicittampi sikkhi, adhipaññampi sikkhi.
an3.84:3.2: tassa adhisīlampi sikkhato adhicittampi sikkhato adhipaññampi sikkhato rāgo pahīyi, doso pahīyi, moho pahīyi.
an3.84:3.3: so rāgassa pahāṇā dosassa pahāṇā mohassa pahāṇā yaṃ akusalaṃ taṃ nākāsi, yaṃ pāpaṃ taṃ na sevīti.
